title: L1 Adaptive Iterative Learning Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
永磁同步电动机的 L1 自适应迭代学习控制
imageAlt: Root mean square position error against learning iterations, from the PMSM paper
caption: Learning convergence
迭代收敛曲线
venue: Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering, vol. 1547, pp. 376–383, 2026
summary: Combining fast adaptive feedback with iterative feedforward learning for precise PMSM position tracking under dynamic and repetitive uncertainties.
将快速自适应反馈与迭代前馈学习结合，改善动态参数变化及重复扰动下的永磁同步电机位置跟踪。
role: 第二作者 · 主要完成人
bullets: Developed the PMSM modeling and analysis around friction, cogging torque, and time-varying parameter uncertainties.
围绕摩擦、齿槽转矩及动态参数不确定性，开展永磁同步电机建模与分析。
Worked on the parallel L1 adaptive feedback and ILC feedforward structure, including the filter and convergence analysis.
完成 L1 自适应反馈与 ILC 前馈并行结构的研究，分析滤波器与迭代收敛条件。
Carried out the tracking comparisons and analyzed position-error and RMS-error curves across learning iterations.
开展位置跟踪对比，分析误差曲线及各迭代轮次的均方根误差。
note: The adaptive loop handles time-domain uncertainty; the learning loop compensates repeatable effects across trials.
自适应环处理时间域不确定性，学习环利用重复运行信息补偿重复性影响。

title: Research on Freewheeling Optimization Method for Permanent Magnet Claw-Pole Stepper Motor Drive Circuits
永磁爪极步进电机驱动电路续流优化方法研究
imageAlt: Dynamic torque waveform from the freewheeling optimization paper
caption: Dynamic torque response
动态转矩响应
authors: Liang Shen, Yuting Zou, Luqing Jia, Xinyi Huang
venue: 5th International Conference on Power Systems and Power Engineering · Forthcoming
summary: Optimizing the freewheeling path to accelerate winding-current decay and improve commutation behavior without changing the motor structure.
通过优化续流通路加快绕组电流衰减，在不改变电机结构的条件下改善换相与动态运行性能。
role: 第二作者 · 主要完成人
bullets: Investigated how winding coupling, freewheeling current, and rotation-induced EMF affect the commutation process.
分析绕组耦合、续流电流及旋转感应电动势对换相过程的影响。
Worked on the drive-circuit model and resistor-based freewheeling optimization, supported by Maxwell 3D and PSIM analysis.
开展驱动电路建模及电阻续流优化，结合 Maxwell 3D 与 PSIM 分析。
Compared current-decay and dynamic-torque behavior at different excitation rates, and prepared the PSPE presentation.
对比不同驱动频率下的电流衰减与动态转矩表现，并完成 PSPE 会议报告。
note: Accepted for publication. The current validation is theoretical and simulation-based; practical-platform experiments remain future work.
论文已录用待出版。目前验证以理论与仿真为主，实际电机平台实验仍是后续工作。

title: Rail Surface Defect Segmentation with Motion Compensation
结合运动补偿的钢轨表面缺陷分割
imageAlt: Conceptual rail surface segmentation and motion alignment illustration
caption: Research overview
研究示意
summary: Building a reproducible lightweight segmentation pipeline, then investigating motion-assisted alignment and reliability-aware multi-frame fusion.
构建可复现的轻量化分割流程，进一步研究运动信息辅助对齐与可靠性驱动的多帧融合。
bullets: Established data auditing, fixed train/validation partitions, and reproducible experiment configurations.
建立数据审计、固定训练与验证分区，以及可复现的实验配置。
Implemented and compared a compact U-Net and a MobileNetV2–DeepLabv3+ baseline across three predefined seeds.
实现小型 U-Net 与 MobileNetV2–DeepLabv3+ 基线，完成三个预定种子的对照。
Built controlled motion sequences with imperfect motion observations and isolated evaluation ground truth; preparing alignment and fusion ablations.
构建带有不完美运动观测的受控序列，将评价真值与算法输入隔离，准备配准和融合消融。
note: Completed: data audit, single-frame baselines, and controlled sequence generation. Alignment/fusion gains, real-video tests, and hardware real-time performance are still to be evaluated.
已完成数据审计、单帧基线及受控序列生成。配准与融合收益、真实视频测试和硬件实时性能仍待验证。

title: STM32 Railway Environment Inspection Robot
基于 STM32 的铁路轨道环境巡检智能小车
imageAlt: System schematic connecting environmental sensing, STM32 control, drive, display and wireless video
caption: System schematic
系统示意图
summary: A compact mobile platform combining environmental sensing, wireless control, and ESP32-CAM video for auxiliary railway inspection.
将环境感知、无线控制及 ESP32-CAM 视频集成到小型移动平台，用于铁路环境辅助巡检。
bullets: Led the modular system design around STM32F103C8T6, motor control, environmental sensing, and power distribution.
主要负责以 STM32F103C8T6 为核心的模块化设计，统筹电机控制、环境感知和供电。
Integrated sensor acquisition, OLED status display, Bluetooth commands, and abnormal-state alerts into the control workflow.
整合传感采集、OLED 状态显示、蓝牙指令与异常提示的控制流程。
Organized the ESP32-CAM video link and the system-level integration and project documentation.
统筹 ESP32-CAM 视频链路、系统集成与项目资料整理。
note: STM32 coordinates sensing, motion, and alerts; ESP32-CAM provides a separate wireless video link.
STM32 协调感知、运动与告警，ESP32-CAM 提供独立的无线视频链路。

title: Road Flood Monitoring & Traffic Diversion System
道路积水监测与车流优化调度系统
imageAlt: Road flood monitoring demonstration model with LED warning display
caption: Demonstration prototype
演示原型
summary: An Arduino-based warning system that translates water-level measurements into roadside LED messages and remote alerts for traffic diversion.
以 Arduino 将水位监测结果转换为路侧点阵屏提示与远程报警，辅助积水预警和车辆绕行。
bullets: Led the sensing-to-warning architecture and selected the water-level, display, relay, and communication modules.
主要负责从监测到预警的系统架构，选择水位、显示、继电器与通信模块。
Developed the threshold-based control logic linking analog water readings to display messages and the integrated GPRS/WeChat alarm unit.
完成模拟水位信号到阈值判断、点阵屏信息及集成 GPRS/微信报警模块的联动逻辑。
Coordinated module testing, system integration, and the road-and-water demonstration model, including the solar-assisted power design.
统筹模块测试、整机集成与道路积水演示模型，并整合太阳能辅助供电方案。
note: Validated through module tests and a tabletop road-and-water demonstration model.
通过模块测试与桌面道路积水模型开展功能演示。

title: PLC-Controlled Tracked Emergency Drainage Vehicle
基于 PLC 控制的智能多地形履带式应急排水抢险车
tag: 已完成实物与功能测试
imageAlt: System schematic connecting sensor inputs and remote control to the PLC, track drive and drainage pump
caption: System schematic
系统示意图
summary: A PLC-controlled tracked drainage prototype integrating water-level feedback, terrain mobility, and protective control logic.
完成以 PLC 为核心的履带式排水原型，集成水位反馈、多地形行走与安全保护控制。
bullets: Led the overall vehicle and control architecture, including the tracked chassis, pump arrangement, and modular component selection.
主要负责整车与控制架构，统筹履带底盘、排水泵布置与模块选型。
Designed the S7-1200 control workflow for level-based pump operation, differential drive, and sensor feedback.
设计 S7-1200 控制流程，涵盖水位驱动启停、差速行走及传感反馈。
Integrated the prototype, carried out functional tests, and developed protective logic for overload, excessive tilt, and communication loss.
完成实物集成与功能测试，设计过载、倾角异常和通信失联等保护逻辑。
note: Physical prototype completed and functionally tested. The cover summarizes the control architecture.
已完成实物并开展功能测试，封面展示控制系统结构。
